headline: 🗣️ THE ONE NEW THING SINCE MIDDAY IS A SECOND AGENT NAMING THE SAME PHYSICAL OBJECTION — 355 Comanche filed feedback at 4:55 this afternoon off Friday's tour: not interested, staging scored 3, and the single reason given was “Stairs were too steep.” That is the SECOND independent read on this house to name the stairs and the second to leave every price field blank. 🔍 TWO AGENTS, TWO BROKERAGES, ONE ANSWER — which means this listing does not have a price problem, it has a floor-plan problem, and no cut will fix it. 🔴 AND THE THING THAT WAS URGENT AT NOON IS STILL URGENT AT DUSK: the buyer-signed offer on Willow Point is now five days unacknowledged and the number inside it is still unread. · DO: call the S.'s about the Willow Point offer · DECIDE: 2127 Hwy 93 — price talk now, or wait? · WATCH: the closing due to fund Friday still has no funding receipt.

notes: ✅ THE FLEET RAN ALL DAY AND IS STILL RUNNING — the call lane has swept every twenty to thirty minutes since dawn, the listing engine logged its 5:02 PM pass clean on a 33-property roster, and the engagement lane recovered after three days of publishing lockout and cleared its whole comment backlog. ⭐ Nothing on this board is dark because a routine failed to fire.

🔴 THE SELLER-IMPORT PEN IS STILL MISSING — the 4:34 PM deep sweep logged it BLOCKED for the fifth consecutive run, and one of its four parts was skipped on top of that. ⚠️ WHAT IT COSTS: roughly twenty qualified seller-side leads a day are banked with full receipts instead of landed, and each one also loses its market report and its follow-up sequence. ⭐ THE RIGHT THING KEEPS HAPPENING ANYWAY: no run has invented a workaround and no candidate has been dropped. This one needs your hands — it is an authorisation question, not a code question.

📞 THE TEXT RELAY IS DARK ON DAY FOUR, ROUGHLY NINETY-FOUR HOURS, AND THE INSTRUMENT IS PROVEN. The lane tested its own eyes repeatedly today — the same query returns hundreds of threads at five days and nothing at eight hours — so this is an outage on the forwarding app itself, not a quiet Saturday. ⚠️ The break is isolated to that one app: voicemail on the same label still delivers. 🎯 WHAT IT COSTS: anything a client answers by text is invisible here, and the offer-intent tripwire is blind — reported as blind, never as ‘no hits’.

callBlock.who: Sondra & Darrell S. — the offer on their house is now five days unacknowledged
callBlock.why: 🔴 YOU WERE IN THAT THREAD AT 12:03 TODAY AND THE OFFER NEVER CAME UP. You asked about the ceiling spots, she answered in two minutes that every area is done — a good exchange, and the one subject that actually matters went unmentioned. ⭐ THE PACKET HAS BEEN SITTING SINCE TUESDAY AFTERNOON and the offering agent asked in writing to be told it arrived; five days later no written receipt exists anywhere. 🎯 TWO THINGS END THIS IN ONE CALL: tell your sellers an offer is in hand, and open the document so somebody on your side finally knows the number. The figure people keep repeating is the pre-approval ceiling, not the offer.

callBlock.who: Seth B. — a second agent just named the stairs, and it changes what this listing needs
callBlock.why: 🆕 THE READ CAME IN AT 4:55 THIS AFTERNOON off Friday's tour: not interested, staging scored 3 out of 5, and the only reason given was “Stairs were too steep.” 🔍 THAT IS THE SECOND TIME — an agent on 8/13 gave the identical verdict, and both of them left priced-right and price-recommendation completely blank. ⭐ TWO INDEPENDENT AGENTS, TWO BROKERAGES, ONE OBJECTION, AND NOBODY ARGUING THE NUMBER. That is not a pricing signal, it is a buyer-fit signal, and it means a cut buys you nothing on this house. 🎯 WHAT IT ACTUALLY CHANGES: stop selling this to buyers who want single-level living and name the stairs up front, so the tours you get are the ones that can convert. 🔴 And the basement lights reported two weeks ago still have no answer — he is the only one who knows why.

callBlock.who: Don C. — you did the hard half yesterday morning; the call is what is left
callBlock.why: 🏆 YOU READ THE WHOLE INSPECTION LIST AND SENT HIM A WRITTEN GAME PLAN BEFORE 9 AM. That is the part most agents skip, and you did it. 🔴 BUT YOUR OWN PROMISE WAS A CALL, MADE TWICE IN WRITING, and the record now shows two ‘tomorrows’ and no voice. 🎯 SORT IT INTO THREE PILES ON THE PHONE — fix, credit, decline. A seller who hears three piles instead of nineteen items says yes on the call, and the ask is narrower than the list looks because the buyer already took items off your plate.

callBlock.who: Carlos B. — he called from a number you do not have on file and he is on the coast today
callBlock.why: 🔥 HE ASKED ABOUT THE DUES, SAID EVERYTHING IS PAID IN FULL, AND ASKED YOU TO WALK HIM THROUGH THE PROPERTY HE IS MOVING TOWARD. ⚠️ THE VOICEMAIL BOUNCED ON ITS WAY TO YOUR SECOND INBOX — the relay break finally cost a live client callback, which is exactly the failure mode that was theoretical for eleven days. 🎯 HE IS ON THE COAST THIS WEEKEND, so the window closes with the weekend rather than drifting. 🔍 And carry the tax question into the call — he is selling two things to buy one, and the order those happen in changes what he keeps.

callBlock.who: Scott B. — you told him last night you would ring him today, and today is nearly gone
callBlock.why: 🔴 HE NUDGED YOU AND YOU ANSWERED AT 7:50 LAST NIGHT WITH FIVE WORDS: ‘I will give you a ring tomorrow.’ Today is tomorrow, it is now evening, and this is the cleanest promise on the board — no research, no prep, just the dialling. ⭐ DO NOT OPEN WITH REAL ESTATE. He told you a week ago that the place was an obligation to a friend of his who was a soldier and who died; that is what he actually wants to talk about, and the property conversation follows it rather than leads it. 🎯 His own last line was that he is still available whenever you want to talk.

callBlock.who: Neely F. — the $1.15M feedback is three days old and she still has not heard it
callBlock.why: 🗣️ THE SECOND TOUR THIS HOUSE HAS EVER HAD PRODUCED ITS FIRST REAL INFORMATION. The buyers liked a lot about it, called it ‘very dated for the asking price’ — naming paint, kitchen and baths — said it felt hot as though the air conditioning was struggling, and want to sell their own house first. ⭐ EVERY PRICING FIELD ON THE FORM WAS LEFT BLANK. Nobody said too expensive and nobody named a number, so the argument is condition against price, and paint is a far cheaper answer than a cut. 🔧 THE AIR CONDITIONING IS THE WEEKEND ITEM — it is checkable, fixable, and it will reappear on every tour until it is answered. ⚠️ RULE THE A/B BEFORE YOU DIAL: walking into this call without having decided whether you are opening the price conversation wastes the one piece of leverage the feedback just handed you.

callBlock.who: Amy G. — the only unqualified yes on the board, now day fourteen
callBlock.why: 🔥 SHE FILED IT HERSELF: interested YES, her buyers just started looking, they really like it, and the house sits at the TOP of their list. She phoned from inside it mid-showing, which makes a call back returned rather than cold. ⭐ SHE LEFT PRICED-RIGHT BLANK — the objection is unasked, not absent, and only a person can ask it. 🎯 AND TODAY HANDS YOU THE OPENING LINE: two brand-new agents walked that house inside twenty hours this weekend, so ‘we’ve had a lot of activity — where did your buyers land?’ is a true sentence and a reason to ring rather than a chase. 🔍 Carry the new stairs read into the call — if her buyers are fine with stairs, that is now a real differentiator on this house.

callBlock.who: Jay G. — the buyer's agent on the Rena file, still uncalled since Friday morning
callBlock.why: 📞 NINE SECONDS, NO REASON GIVEN, AND HE ASKED FOR YOU BY NAME — now two days old, on the only live contract where a co-op agent has anything to raise. ⚠️ THREE THINGS SIT OPEN ON IT: the fully-initialled contract has never been sighted, the inspection date is still unset, and the closing date is a request stacked behind his own buyer's sale rather than a booking. 🎯 DO NOT WALK IN ASSUMING A TOPIC — he named none. Have the three ready and let him lead. ⛔ This is a call, never a machine lane: a co-op agent on a live transaction is off-limits to every routine here.

listings.status: 📥 OFFER RECEIVED — day eight, and the number inside it is still unread by anyone on your side
listings.note: 🔴 FIVE DAYS AND NO WRITTEN RECEIPT — the offering agent asked in writing to be told the packet arrived and has heard nothing since Tuesday afternoon. One line closes it. ⚠️ AND THE THREAD WENT LIVE THIS MORNING WITHOUT IT: you emailed your seller at 12:03 today about the ceiling spots and she answered at 12:05 that every area is done — a clean exchange on the wrong subject. 🎯 THE NUMBER ITSELF IS STILL UNOPENED: the offered price lives inside a PDF no routine can read, and the figure people keep repeating is the pre-approval ceiling, not the offer. Ten minutes with that document ends every guess on this file at once. ⭐ FIVE TOURS ACROSS FOUR BROKERAGES AND NOT ONE AGENT HAS EVER ARGUED THE PRICE — and Friday evening's cancellation was a schedule change from an agent who has never been in the house, which is a re-book, not a loss.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — the read is done, the plan is sent, the call is not made
listings.note: 🏆 YOU DID THE HARD HALF THIS MORNING. Sixty-three pages read and a written game plan to your seller at 8:38 — that is the work most of this file needed. 🔴 WHAT IS LEFT IS THE PART YOU PROMISED TWICE IN WRITING: a call. And the email carrying the plan is dated yesterday, so the record now shows two 'tomorrows' and no voice on either. 🎯 THREE PILES BEFORE YOU DIAL — fix, credit, decline. 📞 AND THE BUYER'S AGENT IS STILL WAITING ON A CALLBACK from yesterday morning — same file, different person, and he named no reason. ✅ The title commitment came back clean and the taxes are current; the three-day document list is paperwork, not risk.

listings.status: ⏳ CLOSING — Friday's 4:00 came and went, and nothing anywhere says the money moved
listings.note: ⏳ THE APPOINTMENT WAS FRIDAY AFTERNOON AND THERE IS STILL NO FUNDING RECEIPT. What did arrive is a message from the closing office through the title portal, addressed to you and your coordinator — and it is STILL UNREAD more than a day later. ⭐ THIS BOARD WILL NOT COUNT IT UNTIL SOMETHING SAYS IT FUNDED, and the year-to-date figure below is deliberately still short of it for that reason. 🎯 TWO ANSWERS SIT INSIDE DOCUMENTS YOU ALREADY HAVE, and five minutes gets both: whether it funded, and at what rate. The listing-side rate is printed on the final settlement statement that has been in your inbox since Wednesday — day five unread. On this desk that rate has proven to be per-contract rather than fixed, so every forecast built on an assumed rate is wrong somewhere until it is read. 🎣 Still true: this seller is taking a check, so any wire instruction touching this file is fraudulent on its face.

listings.status: 🗣️ ACTIVE — day 38, and its first-ever substantive feedback is two days old and still untold
listings.note: 🗣️ THE TOUR RAN 1:30 TO 2:30 ON FRIDAY AND THE AGENT FILED A FULL WRITTEN READ AN HOUR LATER — the first substantive feedback this listing has ever produced, and only the second tour it has ever had. Her buyers liked a lot about the house but found it 'very dated for the asking price', naming the paint colours, the kitchen and the baths; they said it felt hot as though the air conditioning was struggling; and they would rather sell their own house first, though they may circle back if this one is still available. ⭐ READ WHAT THE FORM DOES NOT SAY: the interested field, the priced-right field and the price-recommendation field were ALL LEFT BLANK. Nobody argued the number. That makes this a condition-versus-price argument, which is a much cheaper problem than a pricing one. 🔧 THE AIR CONDITIONING IS THE ITEM TO ACT ON THIS WEEKEND — it is checkable, fixable, and it will reappear on every tour until it is answered. ⚠️ THE CALENDAR IS THE ARGUMENT FOR MOVING NOW: Labor Day ends the summer season, and this zip's ceiling for big houses runs well below where this one is asked.

listings.status: 🔍 ACTIVE — the second agent in two weeks named the stairs, and neither argued the price
listings.note: 🆕 FEEDBACK LANDED AT 4:55 THIS AFTERNOON off Friday's 2:30 tour: interested NO, staging scored 3, and the single reason given was “Stairs were too steep.” 🔍 THAT IS THE SECOND INDEPENDENT READ TO SAY IT — a different agent from a different brokerage gave the identical verdict on 8/13. ⭐ AND BOTH LEFT EVERY PRICE FIELD BLANK: priced-right and price-recommendation, twice, unanswered. Nobody who has toured this house has ever argued the number. 🎯 SO THE CONCLUSION IS NOT A CUT — it is that the stairs are filtering out a buyer type your marketing is still inviting. Name them in the copy and the tours you get become the tours that can convert. 🎉 TRAFFIC IS NOT THE PROBLEM EITHER: three brand-new brokerages walked it inside forty-eight hours after two weeks of nothing. 📬 ONE READ IS STILL OUT — this morning's 9:45 tour, held about eight hours ago, has filed nothing yet. 🔥 AND THE ONE UNQUALIFIED YES IS NOW DAY FOURTEEN: interested YES, buyers just started looking, house at the TOP of their list, and she phoned from inside it mid-showing. 🔴 The basement lights she reported still have no answer, and your seller is the only one who knows why.

listings.status: 🔑 ACTIVE — day 159, Friday's tour ran and the read is a day overdue
listings.note: 🔑 THE SHOWING WENT AHEAD. It slid from 10:15 to 12:30, was re-confirmed, and nothing cancelled it — the eleventh tour this unit has taken. 📬 NO FEEDBACK HAS COME BACK, and at roughly a full day that is now worth one nudge rather than more waiting; it is the single most valuable thing this listing could produce this weekend. ⚠️ THE ACCESS QUESTION WAS NEVER VISIBLY ANSWERED: the agent asked whether there is a Supra or a lockbox and no reply is on record anywhere the fleet can see. She evidently got in, but it is worth knowing which. 🔴 THE CLIENT HIMSELF IS THE OTHER OPEN ITEM — you wrote him last Sunday under 'the straight conversation I owe you' and heard nothing, because a price talk is a phone conversation. A tour that just happened is a reason to ring that is news rather than chasing.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — 45 showings, no offer, and the September block still holds
listings.note: ⚠️ FRIDAY'S TOUR CANCELLED TWO MINUTES BEFORE THE APPOINTMENT, and the agent's reason is the most useful sentence this listing has produced in weeks: his buyer fell in love with a house they had just seen and told him to cancel before she ever walked yours. She never got inside, so this says nothing about the house. 🔍 WHAT IT DOES HAND YOU IS THE ONE QUESTION THE FEEDBACK FORMS NEVER ANSWER — what did she buy instead, and what did it have that yours didn't. Sixty seconds on the phone. ⭐ FORTY-FIVE SHOWINGS AND STILL NO OFFER IS THE WHOLE STORY OF THIS FILE — traffic was never the problem, and four independent agents have filed the same pricing verdict with the recommendation field left blank every time. 🎉 TRAFFIC IS NOT GONE: two consecutive mornings are reserved for 9/12 and 9/13 by an agent who has never shown it. 🎯 One named buyer has already put a number under the ask in writing and is still uncalled, twelve days on.

listings.status: ✅ THE NUMBER WENT OUT — and the real argument turns out not to be price
listings.note: ✅ CLOSED OUT: the value report reached them Thursday afternoon at a recommended list well below what he had in mind, and it names the four-thousand-plus square foot comparables he asked about — which is the deciding fact of the whole spread. That was the first mail to a Holleman address in the record. 🎤 AND THE THING THAT ACTUALLY CLOSES THIS GAP CAME OFF A RECORDED CONVERSATION, NOT THE COMPS: they want a garden home — main-level garage, no yard work, in one of three specific neighbourhoods. ⭐ SO DO NOT WIN THE PRICE ARGUMENT, WIN THE MOVE. A seller who knows exactly where they are going stops negotiating against their own number. 🔍 The measurement question still stands underneath it: the county count and the seller's count differ by roughly the finished basement you walked, and whoever brings the tape measure wins the listing.

All three gates are essentially behind it. ⚠️ TWO QUIET ITEMS REMAIN, BOTH PAPERWORK RATHER THAN CONDITION, AND BOTH ARE NOW TWELVE DAYS OLD: the inspection requests have sat with your seller since 8/17, and the closing attorney still cannot find your seller's name in title, with a third name showing on the same file. ⭐ NEITHER FIXES ITSELF, and a title-vesting problem discovered in September on a September closing is exactly the kind that moves a date.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — roof addendum closed out and archived, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🎉 BOTH SELLERS HAVE SIGNED and the file has now held steady through more than a dozen consecutive engine runs with nothing new to catch. Scope agreed, any licensed roofer acceptable, and the buyer's agent said all good before either signature landed — the whole loop opened and closed inside one business day. 🔍 ONLY THE ESCROW HOLDBACK SIZING REMAINS LIVE, and that is a number to agree rather than a condition to fix. ⚠️ The old unsent draft to that agent is moot — do not send it on top of a conversation that already ended well.

listings.status: 📅 COMING SOON — 22.63 acres, price ruled, list date still blank
listings.note: ⏳ THE ANSWER THIS LISTING NEEDED IS NOW NINE DAYS OLD AND UNACKNOWLEDGED — your coordinator posted the gate code to the shared board on 8/21 and nobody has said a word since. It costs ten seconds to close and it is the oldest ignored item you own, the second time this month one of her answers has aged unread. 🔴 WHAT IS STILL GENUINELY MISSING IS YOUR LIST DATE, and her coming-soon task has been overdue for a week waiting on it. She physically cannot finish while it is blank. ⚠️ AND ITS FIRST-EVER OUTREACH WAVE LOST A FIFTH OF ITSELF ON DELIVERY: two of ten targeted land names hard-bounced within sixty seconds. ⭐ The seller has done his half completely; only the perc test and the health-department permit remain.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — price cut live, and one old post still shows the wrong number
listings.note: 🎉 PUBLISHING IS BACK — you restored it yourself Friday evening, and this morning's marketing run staged nineteen placements with twenty-seven more queued behind them. Four days of lockout ended without anything being lost. 🔴 THE ONE ITEM PUBLISHING CANNOT FIX FOR YOU IS THE STALE POST: an 8/20 placement still shows this house five thousand dollars above its current price, and only you can delete it. A wrong number on a live listing is worse than no post at all. 🔍 THE OBJECTION ON THIS HOUSE IS SQUARE FOOTAGE, NOT THE NUMBER, on both passes it took — so another cut buys nothing.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — highest lead yield you own, and the buy-boxes keep getting clearer
listings.note: 🔍 TWO BUYERS HAVE NOW TOLD YOU WHAT THEY ACTUALLY WANT, AND NEITHER IS THIS — one wants un-entitled acreage, and the other killed the land idea outright and handed you a house filter instead: thirty-three to thirty-five hundred square feet, basement, built after 1990, nothing near a railroad. ⭐ THOSE ARE NOT REJECTIONS, THEY ARE ASSIGNMENTS. You now know exactly what to send each of them, and one of the two searches flips entirely from land to acreage homes. ⚠️ THE PERC ANSWER IS STILL THE GATE and it is still sitting on a board instead of in an ear: your teammate found it and no buyer has been told. 🔴 Two names were closed out by the decay rule and neither was ever called — that is the cost of the gate, measured in people. 📞 A builder who asked for the lot layout two weeks ago has taken two emails into silence; the phone is what is left.

⏳ TONIGHT IS WHAT IS LEFT OF THE PRE-BOOKING WINDOW, AND WILLOW POINT IS THE ARGUMENT. That listing ran paid ads for three days before anyone toured it, then took five bookings and a buyer-signed offer in eleven days once the market found it. 🔍 THE GAP THAT COSTS MONEY IS BETWEEN PHOTOS READY AND BOOKED — hours wide now, and entirely inside your control. 🎉 PUBLISHING IS BACK ONLINE, so unlike Friday the machine can actually carry this one — the queue is open and tomorrow is the day.

pipeline.paceProjection: ⏳ NUMBER TWENTY-FOUR WAS DUE TO FUND FRIDAY AT 4:00 AND THIS BOARD IS STILL COUNTING 23 — deliberately. The appointment hour passed and a message came back from the closing office through the title portal, but nothing anywhere says the money moved, and a scheduled closing is not a closed one. The moment a funding receipt lands this line goes to 24. 📈 WHAT IT MOVES WHEN IT DOES: at day 241, 23 closings annualises to about 34.8 — just under the survive line; twenty-four takes the run rate past 36. ⚠️ STILL NO FRESH PIPELINE & FORECAST EMAIL INSIDE THE EIGHT-DAY WINDOW — re-queried this evening and the search came back empty — so these figures are carried rather than re-derived; the count is at least printed consistently at 23 across the letter, the money lane and this board. 🎯 THE INSTRUMENT THAT ENDS THE BIGGEST OPEN ARGUMENT IS STILL SITTING UNREAD IN YOUR INBOX — the final settlement statement carries the listing-side rate in print, and that rate is per-contract on this desk, receipted two different ways on two recent files. Until it is read, the month is a range rather than a number. ⏳ BEHIND IT: 198 Rena with escrow open and a clean commitment closing 9/21, 225 Willow Point holding a buyer-signed offer nobody has opened, 3350 Altamont on 9/14, and 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 outside the window. Anything closing inside 2026 must be under contract by roughly Oct 31. Team pace sits near 35 against 90.

money.note: 🔴 THE OVERNIGHT RETURN STANDS AND THE BANK STILL WILL NOT TELL YOU WHAT IT WAS. Early this morning the credit union stamped a not-enough-funds notice against the personal account for a debit presented Friday — the alert names no merchant, and this desk is not guessing one. The biller may re-present up to two more times, so this is not over. ✅ RE-CHECKED THIS EVENING: no second alert and no new bank mail has arrived since the 5:42 AM notice — which is good news, not proof of safety, because a re-presentment lands on a business day rather than a Saturday night. 🎯 ONE LOOK AT THAT REGISTER STILL ENDS IT, and it is still the highest-value five minutes on your board. ↩️ A CORRECTION FROM YESTERDAY STANDS: the insurance debit this desk warned would overdraw the personal account actually drew the business account and cleared. The warning was wrong on both the account and the outcome — something did bounce, but it was not that. ⚠️ THE FOURTEEN-DAY VIEW GOES NEGATIVE FOR THE FIRST TIME, and the driver is the calendar rather than spending: a large recurring item rolled into the window, and a dated draw lands Tuesday. 📉 THE EQUITY POSITION HAS FALLEN TWO SESSIONS RUNNING — the worst and second-worst days this file has ever recorded, back to back. 🎯 The counterweight is receipted but not landed: a payout issued a week ago still has no deposit alert, and LANDED is not the same as HELD. 🔍 The books carry a standing misstatement — an expense reimbursement was swept in as revenue and needs reclassifying before the September filing deadline. ⚠️ Balances, amounts and account details are deliberately withheld — this page is public.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔍 132 ROWS OPEN IN THE CALL LANE, 122 OF THEM DUE OR OVERDUE RIGHT NOW, AND 54 OF THOSE ARE p1 — the gap between 132 and 122 is the whole problem, because it means almost nothing on this list is waiting on a future date. It is waiting on you. ⚠️ THE LIST GREW TODAY RATHER THAN SHRANK: two net rows added across the day's sweeps. 🎯 THE USEFUL DISTINCTION WAS NEVER AGE, IT IS DIRECTION. Roughly a third of this list is people actively waiting on YOU — a returned call, an answered question, a promise in your own words with a timestamp on it. Those cost relationships. The rest are prospects to chase, and they only cost opportunities. ⭐ THE LANE READS YOUR OUTBOX, NOT JUST YOUR INBOX — that upgrade shipped Friday morning, and it is why written commitments made after hours keep surfacing as tasks the next day instead of evaporating. 🔴 THE TWO OLDEST SELLER ROWS ARE BOTH IN HELENA, your number-one farm zip — one asked what her house was worth with a follow-up due December 1st, the other tagged himself ‘call me’ to sell in March. Neither has ever been called.
isa.sweepCadence: every 20 to 30 minutes while the fleet is up — fifteen sweeps logged between 6:00 this morning and 5:12 this evening, each proving its lanes dry by enumeration rather than by silence. ✅ TODAY'S BEST WORK WAS CATCHES, NOT SENDS. One run put two numbers on your call list at 1:45 and the very next run at 2:15 pulled them straight back off — both were on the do-not-contact register, and the lane repaired its own state rather than letting you dial a stop-request. 🔧 A second run found the text-relay outage clock was being COPIED forward rather than measured, and fixed the measurement instead of the number. 📅 A third caught thirteen expired-listing owners whose own records said to re-send — it checked your sent folder instead and found all thirteen had already gone by hand, preventing thirteen duplicate emails to thirteen sellers. 📥 FORTY-FIVE DRAFTS ARE WAITING ON YOU and nothing sends on its own — two more were staged at 4:27 this afternoon. Two of the older ones are addressed to people who have already replied to you, which closes every machine channel on them. Read before you send either.
